_comment: Merge into the project's .claude/settings.json. A plugin cannot ship permission
rules — its own settings.json accepts only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine` — so
/efficiency:init writes these into the project instead, and says line by line what
Rules are written as PREFIXES on purpose. An allowlist of exact invocations dies on
the first extra flag, and a dead allowlist is indistinguishable from no allowlist.
The deny list cannot be shipped: only the project knows its own irreversible levers.
The question to answer is — which commands act in seconds, on the outside world, and
do not undo? Release and rollback, anything that writes to production, destructive
data commands. A deny blocks the human too, and revoking one means editing this file.
